VERITAC-2 Clinical T rial, VEPPANU FDA Approval and Rigel License Agreement In the first quarter of 2025, we, along with Pfizer, announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 VERITAC-2 clinical trial in the estrogen receptor 1-mutant, or ESR1m, population, and in the second quarter of 2025, we, along with Pfizer, announced detailed results from this clinical trial.
In the third quarter of 2025, we announced that the FDA accepted the NDA for vepdegestrant and assigned a PDUFA action date of June 5, 2026.
